caption: A drop of blue dye enters still clear water and gradually spreads outward, coloring an expanding region of the water.

clauses.text: The blue dye drop must be positioned directly above the water surface to initiate the spreading motion.
The water must remain still and undisturbed before the dye drop enters to ensure a clean, controlled diffusion pattern.
The dye must disperse gradually outward from the point of entry, visibly coloring an expanding circular region.
The spreading must continue until the dye has diffused to a significant portion of the water volume, maintaining a smooth, non-turbulent transition.
